abstract: Anaplastic seminoma constitutes approximately 17% of total experience with seminoma at Memorial Sloan-Kettering Cancer Center. Among 25 previously untreated patients, 11 (44%) were clinical Stage I, and 14 (56%) were clinical Stage II or III. Treatment of these 25 patients with the same regimens employed for classical seminoma yielded an overall 80% 5-year apparent cure rate. Survival rates were poor in eight previously treated patients referred with recurrence.
abstract_ja: 未分化型セミノーマは、Memorial Sloan-Kettering Cancer Centerにおけるセミノーマ症例の約17%を占める。未治療の25例のうち、11例（44%）が臨床病期Iであり、14例（56%）が臨床病期IIまたはIIIであった。これら25例に古典型セミノーマと同じ治療法を用いたところ、全体の見かけ上の5年治癒率は80%であった。以前に治療を受け再発で紹介された8例では生存率が不良であった。
